title: An Epidemic Threshold Set for Networks
summary: In this paper, we investigate a discrete-time SIS epidemic model and the epidemic thresholds on complex networks. We focus on proposing a community-level epidemic threshold set and establishing a comparative result between the local epidemic thresholds and the global epidemic threshold. To verify our theoretical findings and structural properties, we conduct numerical experiments on one synthetic network (Network1) and one real-world network (the Haslemere contact network).
